title: Project Memory Store
description: Shared memory for the AI Product Discovery Platform. A store is a versioned collection of memory records that skills and agents read from and write to, so discovery work compounds across sessions instead of starting cold each time.

version.description: Schema version this store's records were written against, e.g. "1.0.0".

records.description: The memory records in this store.

record.title: Memory Record
record.description: A single unit of durable discovery knowledge: an insight, decision, assumption, persona, competitor profile, market signal, opportunity, risk, feature idea, or research source.

id.description: Stable unique identifier for this record (e.g. a UUID or a short slug). Referenced by other records via related_ids.

type.description: What kind of thing this record represents.

title.description: Short, human-scannable label for the record.

summary.description: One to a few sentences capturing the substance of the record.

details.description: Optional longer-form Markdown body with full context, elaboration, or supporting narrative.

tags.description: Free-form labels for filtering and grouping (e.g. project or theme names).

status.description: Current lifecycle state of the record. Prefer updating status over deleting records, so the history of what was believed stays intact.

confidence.description: How much this record should be trusted absent further validation.

sources.description: Evidence this record is based on, so claims stay traceable.

label.description: Human-readable name of the source (e.g. "Customer interview - Acme Corp, 2026-07-14").

reference.description: URL, file path, or other pointer to the source material.

related_ids.description: IDs of other records this one relates to, supports, or was derived from. Use this to link records instead of duplicating their content.

owner.description: Name of the skill or agent that created or last materially updated this record.

session_id.description: Optional identifier for the Claude Code session that produced this record, for traceability.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the record was first created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the record was last modified.
